family_context.name: Spanisch inspirierter Trupp
family_context.visual_context: Spanish Civil War/interwar-era inspired army archetype mixture in dusty khaki and olive, not a WWII combatant faction or one documented historical unit; blank uniforms and headgear
family_context.relationship_policy: Shared visual military family only; not a documented historical unit, nor binding pair/state/trio/combat-tier assignments
family_context.satirical_target: Military bureaucracy, certainty, hierarchy and human coping; not inherent national character
